Package paint.generatesquares.calc

Class SquareGenerationService

java.lang.Object
paint.generatesquares.calc.SquareGenerationService
public final class SquareGenerationService extends Object
Pure, in-memory square-generation computation for a single recording.

Operates on a loaded Recording (with its tracks) and mutates it in place with the generated squares and their computed attributes. It performs no experiment loading and writes no output files — those I/O steps stay in the orchestrator (GenerateSquaresProcessor.generateSquaresForExperiment), so this computation can be exercised directly in tests.

The only side outputs reachable from here are optional and off by default: a debug CSV (enabled by the Debug flag) and plot PNGs (enabled by the plot flags); experimentPath is used only for the latter.

  • Method Details

    • computeRecording

      public static boolean computeRecording(Recording recording, GenerateSquaresConfig config, Path experimentPath) throws IOException
      Runs the full per-recording computation: grid generation, track assignment, and square-level and recording-level attribute calculation. The recording is mutated in place.
      Parameters:
      recording - the loaded recording (with its tracks)
      config - the generate-squares configuration
      experimentPath - experiment directory, used only for optional plot output
      Returns:
      true if the computation completed; false if the thread was interrupted mid-computation (before attribute calculation)
      Throws:
      IOException - only if optional debug output is enabled and fails

    • computeExperiment

      public static boolean computeExperiment(Experiment experiment, GenerateSquaresConfig config, Path experimentPath) throws IOException
      Runs the computation for a whole loaded experiment: every recording flagged for processing is computed in place, and the selection parameters actually used are then stamped onto every recording so they travel with the output.

      This reads nothing and writes nothing. The caller loads the Experiment and, if this returns true, writes the results — which keeps the pipeline a plain load → compute → write and lets the whole computation be exercised in a test without a project directory to write into.

      Parameters:
      experiment - the loaded experiment (recordings with their tracks)
      config - the generate-squares configuration
      experimentPath - experiment directory, used only for optional plot output
      Returns:
      true if the computation completed; false if it was cancelled
      Throws:
      IOException - only if optional debug output is enabled and fails
